text:
Maya (Growth): quick heads-up — we need social + blog copy for the new mini-labs (3 short tutorials + refapp) and a simple inbound lead routing plan. target launch next Tue. who can own the narrative/benchmark blurb?
Aj Patel: I can draft the benchmark narrative — short perf numbers + dev velocity angle. will need numbers from eng.
Leo - DevRel: I’ll own the refapp README and sample code snippets. can we make the code <100 LOC per lab and include a 'deploy to local' one-liner?
Maya (Growth): yes, low friction is key. main marketing asks: 1) launch post (OSS framing), 2) 2-3 social snippets, 3) webinar CTA (optional), 4) inbound routing -> which list + follow-up flow.
Sam W: for inbound routing — propose a simple flow: form -> tag as "mini-lab-interest" -> drip (3 emails) -> invite to office hours. we should route high-usage trials to sales dev.
Leo - DevRel: thumbs up. for code snippets I’ll include an examples folder and a tiny benchmark script. sample snippet idea:```bash
# run minimal demo
python run_demo.py --model redwood-small --input "hello"
```
Maya (Growth): love that. Aj, can you draft a 2-paragraph benchmark blurb that highlights latency and cost-per-demo? keep numbers relative (e.g., "~50ms p95 on local GPU, 4-5x cheaper with caching") if exacts not ready.
Aj Patel: will do. also thinking of a short narrative: "learn-by-building: three bite-sized labs to ship a feature with predictable inference economics". keep tone friendly/dev-first.
Sam W: quick note on GDPR/inbound — add a checkbox on the form for product updates and an enterprise interest flag. route enterprise leads to pd-ops@redwood.
Maya (Growth): @Leo please add a one-click GH template for issues labeled "mini-lab-bug" so community feedback funnels back to us. also need 3 alt social captions: short, medium, long.
Leo - DevRel: done — will add template + CONTRIBUTING.md snippet.
ciara-bot: checklist created: [x] draft benchmark blurb (Aj) [x] refapp README (Leo) [ ] marketing blog draft (Maya) [ ] social snippets (Maya) [ ] inbound form + tags (Sam) [ ] email drip (Growth Ops). link: https://drive.redwood/mini-labs/launch-pack
Maya (Growth): planning cadence: Aj first pass by EOD Fri, Leo sample code by Mon noon, Sam form wired by Mon EOD, I’ll assemble blog and socials Mon night for internal review Tue morning. shout if blockers. :rocket:
